Author: tsengleo
Name: autoLeve
Punchline: Semi-auto A↔B leve pickup and turn-in loop for marked NPCs.
Description: AutoLeve provides a semi-automatic crafting leve loop: target NPC A (attack1) to accept the configured leve, then target NPC B (attack2) to turn in items, and repeat until leve allowance is exhausted. Main controls are in the AutoLeve Control Panel. Slash command: /alevetest semi start|stop|status|dump.
